correctness.rationale: Finite chain-ring valuation gives ann(u*pi^i)=m^(ell-i), so compressed classes are exactly i=1,...,ell-1 and adjacency is i+j>=ell. This is A_(ell-1). The pendant/universal recurrence A_(m+2)=K1 join (K1 union A_m) supports a simultaneous induction on the ordinary zero forcing number and the least size of a ready zero forcing set. The case split on whether neither, exactly one, or both new vertices are initially blue proves k_(m+2)=k_m+1, r_(m+2)=k_m+2, a_(m+2)=2a_m+b_m, and b_(m+2)=a_m+b_m. The initial values at A2 and A3 yield the stated Fibonacci counts. Published threshold-graph theory gives M=Z, hence the minimum-rank formula. Exhaustive replay confirms all recurrences through m=12.

value.rationale: The accepted theorem gives an exact infinite-family forcing classification and Fibonacci enumeration of all minimizers for a canonical compressed algebraic graph. It cleanly separates information preserved by annihilator compression—nilpotency length—from information lost, while connecting the compressed ring graph to the extremal antiregular threshold family.
